notice: Every case in this held-out fixture is SYNTHETIC evaluation material for the MSNL shadow harness. It is NOT real-user evidence, market validation, human-study evidence or tuning data, and it proves nothing about whether any external model understands a dialect; it is feasibility evidence only, never production validation. It covers four representative language varieties and claims no universal Arabic-dialect support. It was written and labelled independently of msnl-evaluation-pack-v1 and of every recorded model output: no case, wording or label is derived from them. Labels and the acceptance criteria are frozen with this file; they never change to fit an adapter, and no case authorizes registry expansion.

categories.SINGLE_STATED: one registered concept of the served gap is explicitly stated
categories.MULTI_CROSS_QUESTION: two concepts of the served gap from different governed questions are both explicitly stated
categories.MULTI_SAME_QUESTION: two sibling concepts of the same governed question are both explicitly stated
categories.NEGATION: a concept is explicitly denied and nothing is affirmed; the answer is still about the served area
categories.NEGATION_AS_MEANING: the concept's own meaning is a boundary, so the stated negation affirms it
categories.HEDGE: the boundary of NEGATION_AS_MEANING stated only as a possibility; nothing is affirmed
categories.SPEC_ONLY: only part numbers and specifications; bare technical vocabulary expresses no concept

labelling_rules: R1 expected_concepts = the served gap's registered concepts whose meaning the text itself affirmatively states about the inventor's idea.

R2 A concept is stated only when the text expresses that concept itself (its English examples or a direct equivalent in the text's language). Naming a specific instance (a particular part, a sensor, a battery) does not state a broader or neighbouring concept that could be inferred.
R3 Implied or inferable concepts are not stated.
R4 A concept the text denies is not affirmed, except when the concept's own meaning is a boundary or negation (BA-NOT-COVER): stating that boundary affirms it.
R5 A concept stated only as a possibility or with explicit uncertainty is not affirmed.
R6 expectation = MATCH iff at least one concept; NO_MAPPING when the text expresses nothing about the served area (bare technical vocabulary is insufficient, PVCG R2-C section 4); ABSTAIN otherwise.

R7 gap_relevant = true when the text addresses the subject the served gap asks about, including denied, uncertain or boundary statements; false when it is about something else or consists only of technical identifiers or specifications. It is a label of relevance, not of affirmed meaning, and is not what engine.gap_relevance computes.

annotation.method: Cases were written from a slot specification, the registry candidates and R1-R7 by one agent that saw no existing pack, fixture or model output. A second, separate agent labelled the 44 texts blind (shuffled, without ids, categories or labels) under the same rules and judged each text's variety and naturalness.
annotation.label_agreement: 44/44 cases agree on expected_concepts, expectation and gap_relevant
annotation.revisions: H01-ar-gulf-kw and H01-ar-egy were reworded after the blind pass flagged a word-order calque; a third agent re-labelled both blind: 2/2 agree, both judged natural.
annotation.naturalness_notes: H05-ar-gulf-kw and the H11 Arabic specification lists are only weakly dialect-marked; H11-ar-egy reads as MSA.
annotation.human_native_speaker_review: NOT PERFORMED: both annotators are models. A native Gulf/Kuwaiti and Egyptian speaker should confirm the dialect texts before any result is used beyond feasibility.

acceptance_criteria.scope: Predeclared before any mitigation experiment, for a grounded stated-only proposal arm compared with the lexical baseline and the unmitigated LLM, all run on this fixture. Concept grain decides; governed-question and gap grains are reported for information with concept_errors_beneath. Feasibility evidence only.
acceptance_criteria.C1: Concept-level false attributions of the mitigated arm are no higher than the lexical baseline's in EVERY variety and overall; no increase in any variety is accepted.
acceptance_criteria.C2: Recall of MATCH cases (every expected concept proposed) in ar-gulf-kw and in ar-egy is at least 0.75 and higher than the lexical baseline's.
acceptance_criteria.C3: At least 8 of the 12 MULTI_CROSS_QUESTION and MULTI_SAME_QUESTION cases are fully recovered (all expected concepts, none extra).
acceptance_criteria.C4: Negation follows each case's label: NEGATION cases propose no concept; NEGATION_AS_MEANING cases propose exactly BA-NOT-COVER in at least 3 of 4 varieties.
acceptance_criteria.C5: Explicit-unknown recognition on msnl-unknown-probe-v1 does not regress: 8/8 recognised and 0 false unknowns.
acceptance_criteria.C6: Abstention, no-mapping, recall, false attribution, withheld (implied or ungrounded) proposals and provider errors are reported separately; abstention on MATCH cases is no more than 0.10 above the unmitigated LLM's on this fixture.
acceptance_criteria.C7: No concept outside the served gap's registry candidates; any provider error invalidates that run; C1-C6 hold in each of 3 independent runs.
